summary: Time-shifts a CHOP by changing the start and end interval while preserving the channel contents.
key_concepts: Shift CHOP changes the start and end interval of a CHOP while keeping the channel contents the same.
Reference selects whether start or end position is used as the alignment reference.
Unit Values decides whether Start and End are absolute, relative to the input start/end, or relative to the current frame.
Scroll Offset moves samples within the unchanged interval length.
The $C variable can shift each channel differently through Scroll or Start/End parameters.
The optional second input supplies a Start/End Reference for aligning the first CHOP to another CHOP interval; output channels still come from the first input.

key_params.name: reference
key_params.note: Use start or end position as the alignment reference

key_params.name: refstart
key_params.note: Use the CHOP start as the reference

key_params.name: refend
key_params.note: Use the CHOP end as the reference

key_params.name: relative
key_params.note: Absolute, relative to start/end, or relative to current frame

key_params.name: rel
key_params.note: Interpret Start/End relative to input start/end

key_params.name: cur
key_params.note: Use the current frame as the new start position

key_params.name: scroll
key_params.note: Scroll samples within the unchanged interval length

common_gotchas: Channel contents remain the same; the CHOP interval is shifted.
Scroll changes sample placement within the range without changing the CHOP length.
Use the $C variable in Scroll or Start/End to shift each channel differently by index.
Optional second Start/End Reference input aligns the first input relative to another CHOP interval.
The second input only supplies interval/reference information; output channels come from the first input.
Relative-to-current-frame ignores Start/End values and uses the current frame as the new start.
